meta.title: GoNuts
meta.description: Auction trading for DonutSMP. A free, open source Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2 that reads the market, places orders, and lists what it buys, inside limits you set.
meta.ogDescription: A free, open source Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2. Reads the market, places orders, lists what it buys. Off by default, inside limits you set.

hero.title: Trade the DonutSMP auction house on autopilot
hero.lede: A Fabric mod that reads the market, places buy orders, and lists what it buys. It stays inside the limits you set, and it is off until you turn it on.

desk.label: Your trading desk
desk.sub: It watches the market, bids, buys and relists, and it lights up when a sale lands.

faces.alt: The bot with dollar signs for eyes
faces.caption: A sale landed

install.label: Install
install.title: Six steps from download to trading
install.lede: Watch it through, or pick a step to jump the video to it.

steps.how: Minecraft Java 26.2, Fabric Loader for 26.2, and the Fabric API mod.
One file: `GoNuts-0.1.0-mc26.2.jar` from the Releases page.

steps.what: Put it in your mods folder
steps.how: Close Minecraft first. The folder is `%appdata%\.minecraft\mods`.
Turn the sidebar scoreboard on in `/settings`. GoNuts reads your balance from it.
Check Max per trade and Max per session. Start small.
Click the button, click again within 8 seconds to confirm, press Start.

install.after: After that, leave the game window open and visible with no menu left open. The End key stops it at once.

discord.label: Discord
discord.title: Run it from Discord in six steps
discord.lede: A bot inside the mod posts one message in a channel of yours and keeps it up to date. You start, stop and tune the trader from the buttons under it. New to Discord bots? Watch it through: every click is spelled out.

video.caption: Setting up the Discord panel, with captions

steps.how: A Discord account, a server you own, and GoNuts already trading.

steps.what: Create the bot and copy its token
steps.how: On `discord.com/developers/applications`: New Application, then Bot, then Reset Token.
OAuth2, URL Generator: tick `bot`, then View Channels, Send Messages and Attach Files.
Turn on Developer Mode, right-click the channel, then right-click your own name.
Press B, open Autopilot, click the top right button twice, paste, Save.
Pick a page from the dropdown. Start and Stop work like the buttons in game.

discord.after: The bot token is a password. Never post it or share it. If it gets out, press Reset Token on the developer page and paste the new one into GoNuts.

cards.title: No API key
cards.text: DonutSMP switched off its public API. GoNuts reads the market from what the game shows: order house fills, live auction prices, and your own sales.

cards.title: Both sides of the market
cards.text: It places buy orders in the order house, collects what fills, and lists it on the auction house. It also buys underpriced listings and relists them.

cards.title: Limits you set
cards.text: A cap per trade and per session, a dry run mode, and an emergency stop. When something does not match, it stops instead of guessing.

cards.title: Rivals and money
cards.text: Follow other players and see what they order and list, which markets they work, and who pays whom among them.

cards.title: Run it from Discord
cards.text: One live panel in a channel of yours shows what the bot is doing, with buttons to start, stop and tune it.

cards.title: Keeps itself current
cards.text: It tells you when a new build is out and what it changes. Turn on auto-update and it installs when you close the game.

screen.label: The screen
screen.title: Everything on one key
screen.lede: Press B in game. Opportunities, live markets, the order house, rivals, performance and every setting are in one place.

risk.title: Know the risk before you turn it on
paragraphs: DonutSMP's rules ban scripts, macros and auto-clickers, and enforcement can reach every account linked to a player. Running live trading is a ban risk that you, the account owner, choose to take.
Watching prices and reading the screens carry no such risk; live trading does. GoNuts is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by DonutSMP.
